annotations.title: Extended Power Mean
annotations.description: Extends M_r to all r ∈ ℝ by defining M_0 = GM via a dependent if (dite).
annotations.mathematicalContent: extWeightedPowerMean(r) = GM if r = 0, else M_r

annotations.title: Main Theorem: Unified Monotonicity
annotations.description: The key result: M_r ≤ M_s for ALL r ≤ s. The four-case proof unifies all previous special cases.
annotations.mathematicalContent: ∀ r ≤ s : ℝ, extWeightedPowerMean s w z r ≤ extWeightedPowerMean s w z s

annotations.title: HM ≤ GM ≤ AM
annotations.description: The classical harmonic-geometric-arithmetic mean inequality as a direct corollary of the unified theorem.
annotations.mathematicalContent: M_{-1} ≤ GM ≤ M_1, i.e., HM ≤ GM ≤ AM

annotations.title: Monotone Family
annotations.description: The power mean r ↦ M_r is a Monotone function in Mathlib's sense.
